title: MSP Skill Dependency
description: A dependency edge from one MSP skill or pack to another protocol artifact. For local skill and skill_pack dependencies, v0.1 resolves the indexed manifest id and applies deterministic semantic-version matching via resolution.strategy.

requirement.description: For local skill and skill_pack dependencies, a semantic version used with resolution.strategy. Other dependency types may use a URI or capability expression understood by the resolver.

strategy.description: Version matching strategy for local skill and skill_pack dependencies. exact requires equality; compatible is semver-compatible and at least the requirement; latest_patch allows newer patches within the same major/minor; latest_minor allows newer minors within the same major; manual is treated as exact by the local deterministic resolver.

allow_prerelease.description: Permit prerelease resolved versions for local skill and skill_pack semantic-version matching. Prereleases are rejected by default.
